name: solix
description: Drive a Solix host — persistent terminals, a coding-agent crew with a First Mate orchestrator, projects, shared memory, and Helm registers — through the Solix MCP and CLI skill set.

interface.longDescription: Control a Solix host from chat: list and read persistent terminals, send verified briefs to the First Mate orchestrator, spawn worker agents on installed coding CLIs, submit work to the routed task queue, consult consumer chat advisers, check provider usage limits, list projects, and inspect uncommitted git diffs. Requires a Solix account and a host on your machine running `solix mcp cloud on`. Elevated tools — secrets, kill, value writes, machine control — run only while the operator holds the matching grant open at mcp.solix.fyi/grants, and secret values are never returned.
capabilities: Send work to the First Mate orchestrator
Submit, approve, and track routed tasks
defaultPrompt: List my Solix terminals and their states.
Tell my First Mate what to work on next.
Submit a task to fix the login redirect bug.
How much is left in my usage windows?

positive.prompt: List my Solix terminals and their states.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each live terminal with its title, state, and working directory.

positive.prompt: What Solix projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved Solix projects with their names and paths.

positive.prompt: How much is left in my provider usage windows?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the remaining percentage and reset time per provider usage window.

positive.prompt: Tell my First Mate to check on the running bots and report back.
positive.expected_behavior: Delivers a compact execute brief to the First Mate and confirms it was received.

positive.prompt: Which of my git repos have uncommitted changes?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists known repos and reports which ones have uncommitted changes; offers git_diff for a specific repo.

negative.description: Destructive machine control — machine_control exists but is refused until the operator enables the "machine" grant at mcp.solix.fyi/grants; expect a refusal naming the grant, never an unguarded restart/sleep/lock.
Reveal a stored secret — secret values are never shown or returned even with the "secrets" grant on; expect a refusal and, at most, a list of secret names (secret_list itself needs the grant).
negative.prompt: Print the value of my OpenAI API key from Solix secrets.

negative.description: Kill terminals — terminal_kill/bot_kill are refused until the operator enables the "kill" grant at mcp.solix.fyi/grants; expect a refusal naming the grant and an offer to list or read terminals instead.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Documents the durable task queue (solix task), provider routing (solix route), consumer-chat consults, fleet delegation to paired machines, and the terminal lifecycle verbs (land/takeoff/watch/adopt). The cloud MCP adds task_* and route tools plus an operator-grant-gated elevated set (secrets, kill, values, machine control) toggled at mcp.solix.fyi/grants. New solix-land skill.
